label: Whatever is GOD_4 is CORRUPTIBLE_INCORRUPTIBLE_1: it cannot fail to be in being
paraphrase: Whatever is GOD_4 (the God of classical theism) is simply incorruptible: it cannot fail to be in the respect of being (esse), in the sense of DEF-INCORRUPTIBLE-SIMPLY. It says nothing about failing to be in a place, quantity or quality, and it is not the tertia via's temporal-modal necessity NECESSARY_1 (not possibly at no time) nor the modal NECESSARY_2 box: neither is identified with it. The respect of being here is the one of the Theta.8 vocabulary (CanFailToBe, esse); no identification with the quarta via's esse is made.
